name: vida-platform (E2E / dev — Linux Chromium)
//: Lets the OPFS/Playwright E2E run on a Playwright-supported OS (Linux) — the coverage macOS 12 can't give (e2e/CLAUDE.md). Works as a GitHub Codespace OR a local Docker DevContainer (VS Code 'Reopen in Container'), so verification never depends on paid CI.
//postCreate: the typescript-node:24 image ships pnpm; corepack prepare was flaky (signature verify) so we use the image's pnpm directly, falling back to an npm global install if absent.
postCreateCommand: sh -c 'command -v pnpm >/dev/null || npm i -g pnpm@9.15.9; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @vida/web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium'
